policy.quarantineRule: An artifact without a publisher-provided cryptographic digest may be acquired into an isolated quarantine path only. It may not be extracted, imported, executed, modified, or used to create a derivative until its SHA-256 is computed, recorded here, and its contents pass the denied-path scan.
policy.derivedWorkDescription: Genesis POC outputs must be described as Genesis-maintained derivatives where upstream geometry or target data contributes to them.
